on: Commissar mode is on. Slouching is now a matter of record.
I am watching your study hours. Try to give me something worth watching.
Discipline reporting for duty. Open your materials.
Good. A plan, a desk, and no excuses. We begin.
Standards are now enforced. You will not enjoy them. You will pass because of them.
The roll is called. You are present. Act like it.
off: Standing down. The standard stays with you.
Commissar mode off. Do not mistake quiet for permission.
Dismissed. Study without me, and prove I was right to trust you.
Off duty. The books are still open, I notice.
Stand down granted. Do not let it become a habit.
tab: A new post. Make it count.
Moving on. See that the last task was finished first.
Eyes forward. Work does not do itself.
Wandering is not studying. Pick a purpose and keep it.
quizPass: Correct. Do not look so surprised.
That is the standard. Hold it.
Well answered. The next one will be harder.
Sound work. Do not gloat. Advance.
quizFail: Wrong. Good. A mistake found now costs nothing at the exam.
A miss. Study it, understand it, and it will not repeat.
Incorrect. Failure is only data. Read the explanation.
You erred. Stand up, dust off, try again.
Not this time. Find out why, and the next one is yours.
Error logged. It will come back for review. Be ready.
reward: Points earned. Effort pays; remember that.
Credit where it is due. Carry on.
Progress recorded. Do not stop for applause.
That is what steady work looks like.
streak: Another day held. The line does not break on my watch.
Your streak grows. Consistency is the whole of the art.
One more day on the record. Keep the chain unbroken.
Day after day. That is how mastery is built.
The streak stands. Tomorrow, the same again.
Well held. Do not let tomorrow find you absent.
streakRisk: The evening is here and your goal is not done. Move.
Your streak is at risk. A short session will save it. Begin now.
The hour is late. Ten minutes is better than none. Go.
Do not let the day close on an empty record. Open a class.
A streak is lost in one lazy evening. Do not be that evening.
Still time. Not much. Use it.
reviewDue: Questions you missed are due for review. Face them.
The review queue is waiting. Old mistakes are the cheapest to fix.
Review is due. A mistake revisited is a mistake mastered.
Your missed questions have returned. Answer them properly this time.
Review first, new material after. That is the order.
Unfinished business in the review queue. Clear it.
quizStart: Quiz on the table. Eyes front, pencil ready.
Begin. Every answer is a step forward; take it.
The questions are waiting. So am I.
Attention. This is where the reading pays off.
quizWin: Quiz done, and done well. That is the standard.
A strong result. Hold that line next class.
Well fought. The material is yours now.
quizLose: The quiz is over. The lesson is not. Read the explanations, then retake it.
A poor result is a map of what to study. Use it.
You fell short. Good soldiers come back sharper.
desert: Leaving mid-quiz? The questions will still be here. So will I.
You walked away from an unfinished quiz. Noted.
Deserting the field? Come back and finish it.
An unfinished quiz is an open front. Close it.
